Newton printed the hymn under Romans 5:21. The line that comes closest to it is marked.
so that, just as sin reigned in death, so also grace might reign through righteousness to bring eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord. ROMANS 5:21 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ ROMANS 5

Now may the LORD reveal his face, And teach our stamm’ring tongues To make his sovereign, reigning grace, The subject of our songs: No sweeter subject can invite A sinner’s heart to sing; Or more display the glorious right Of our exalted King. STANZA I
